name: What should I look for in a luxury home beyond typical features?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a luxury home beyond typical features?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond standard features, luxury home buyers should consider aspects like advanced smart home technology, high-end security systems, and unique architectural design or historical significance. Evaluate the exclusivity of the neighborhood, privacy levels, and access to elite services or amenities, which are prominent in areas like Fisher Island or Highland Beach. It's also critical to assess the quality of construction materials and finishes, and how the property's design supports a specific lifestyle, such as entertaining or wellness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for advanced smart home tech, high-end security, unique architecture, neighborhood exclusivity, privacy, elite services, and quality construction tailored to your lifestyle.
